svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · MULTIMODAL VISUAL TOKEN PRUNING (#394)
Progressive FastV / PyramidDrop vs. Unpruned Tiling & Perceiver Resamplers
Keeping 100% Visual Tokens in Layers 1..2 Then Pruning 80% in Upper Layers Cuts VLM KV Cache by 77.9% at 94.0% Accuracy
• Tier 1 (Unpruned 8K Patches): 1,820 ms TTFT & 2.62 GB KV/req
without knowing the user's text query -> blurs tiny invoice text!
• DocVQA Accuracy Collapses From 94.2% to 68.5% (-25.7 pts!)
• Layers 1..2: Keep 100% tokens so text query absorbs OCR details
• Layers 3..16: Prune 50% low-attention background whitespace patches
• Layers 17..80: Keep only Top-20% query-relevant visual tokens!
• 480 ms TTFT (3.8x Faster), 0.58 GB KV (-77.9%) & 94.0% Accuracy
4-Tier Multimodal Visual Token Compression Matrix (8,192 Patches · 72B VLM)
Tier 1 (Unpruned 8K All 80 Layers) : TTFT = 1820ms | KV/Req = 2.62 GB | DocVQA = 94.2% | Cap = 22 req/node
Tier 2 (Pre-LLM 64-Tok Resampler) : TTFT = 240ms | KV/Req = 0.21 GB | DocVQA = 68.5% | Cap = 180 req/node
Tier 3 (2x2 Pixel-Shuffle Merger) : TTFT = 680ms | KV/Req = 1.15 GB | DocVQA = 92.8% | Cap = 50 req/node
Tier 4 (2x2 + PyramidDrop/FastV) : TTFT = 480ms | KV/Req = 0.58 GB | DocVQA = 94.0% | Cap = 98 req/node
